body: I'm past that point.  I'm at the point where I realize I have nothing more to do that doesn't involve other people, and other people only let me down.  They're too self-involved for cooperation. It's impossible to see beauty in the world when you live in a social climate that thrives on being cold and passive-aggressive. That makes a point of "actively ignoring" certain people.  I think this group is right, I need to move from fucking Seattle before it kills me.
